ns2:course.label: Athl Training Directed Observ
ns2:course.description: Directed observation and acquisition of athletic training skills for selection into the nationally accredited Commission on Accreditation of Allied Health Education Programs (CAAHEP) Athletic Training Education Program. Emphasis is on acquisition of athletic training skills and the UIUC's athletic training educational program policies and procedures. May be repeated to a maximum of 4 hours. Prerequisite: KIN 120 or concurrent enrollment, or consent of Kinesiology advisor.
